description: Check a group order by its code, when the user asks who's in, what's been ordered or whether it has closed. Returns each person's name, items and whether they've paid, the total paid so far, when it closes, and, once it has closed, the status of the shop's combined order (paid, ready or collected). Anyone with the code can check it; it changes nothing. To add the user's own items, use join_group_order; to close it early as the organiser, use close_group_order.

code.description: The group order's code, from start_group_order or as the organiser shared it.

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

name: group_order_status
title: Check a group order
